verdict.line: You lose if you eat early Q pokes while sitting at range, you win if you close distance and make Gnar fight in melee.

brief.thesis: Gnar's entire kit is built around kiting from range and escaping with E (Hop); strip away distance and his small form has almost nothing to answer Irelia in melee. The 53.6% win rate over 2303 games reflects that once Irelia's E (Flawless Duet) is online she can mark, stun, and Q-reset onto Gnar faster than his 22-12s E cooldown lets him reposition.

theirWindow.when: rage bar near full, about to transform
theirWindow.what: Back off mid-trade rather than committing E (Flawless Duet) or an all-in — Mega Gnar's W (Wallop) stuns in an area and his R unlocks, so getting caught at that exact moment turns a winning trade into a dead Irelia.

yourWindow.when: 4 passive stacks up and his E is down
yourWindow.what: Q (Bladesurge) onto him immediately. In small form Gnar has no dash or blink besides E (Hop, 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s) — if that's on cooldown he is stuck trading in melee where your passive attack speed and on-hit damage outclass him.

start.why: The 53.6% win rate over 2344 games comes from the sustain and early trade damage you need to survive Gnar's Q poke before your E comes online at level 2.

boots.why: Picked in 77.9% of games at 52.9% win rate — flattens the auto-attack chip damage Gnar stacks up while kiting before he's forced into melee.

core.why: Early power spike with a slow on hit, which is exactly what you need to stop Gnar from re-creating range after a Q dash.
Side-lane dueling and pushing power that keeps punishing him even if he tries to disengage to a tower.
The 58.6% win rate path over 442 games — on-hit damage and attack speed scale directly with your passive's stacking mechanic.

situational.when: trades are turning into extended all-ins and you need the sustain to outlast his Mega Gnar burst
fights are short and you need to burst him down before he can hop away
his jungler is adding kill pressure to the lane and you need a safety net to keep diving

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks from sustained melee contact, converting to healing once you've closed the gap — it directly offsets the chip damage Gnar deals while kiting before you lock him down.

summoners.why: Run at 53.8% win rate and picked in 77.9% of games. Ignite punishes all-in Q (Bladesurge) kills before Gnar's E (Hop, 22-12s cooldown) is back up to let him escape, and Flash covers the gap-close if he hops away first.

playing.title: Trade in melee, not at range
playing.detail: Small-form Gnar has no answer to sustained melee contact. Walk up and force autos whenever his E (Hop) is down.

playing.title: Engage at 4 passive stacks
playing.detail: Ionian Fervor caps out at max stacks with bonus on-hit damage — look to commit your all-in right as that cap hits.

playing.title: Respect the rage bar
playing.detail: Don't commit E (Flawless Duet) or R (Vanguard's Edge) the moment he's about to transform — Mega Gnar's W (Wallop) stun can turn your engage into his kill.

playing.title: Reset Q through your Mark
playing.detail: Landing E (Flawless Duet) marks him, so your next Q (Bladesurge) refreshes its cooldown — chain this to keep sticking through his kite attempts.

playing.title: Charge W into his poke
playing.detail: W (Defiant Dance) reduces incoming physical damage while charging, which blunts his Boomerang Throw poke phase before you're in range to punish.

playing.title: Thin the wave to kill his bounce
playing.detail: Gnar's E bounces off minions or champions for extra distance. A thin wave removes that follow-up escape option.

playing.title: Build BORK first regardless of path
playing.detail: The slow on hit is what actually keeps Mega Gnar's bulk in your Q range instead of letting him kite out the fight.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, boots, runes, summoners and the 53.6% head-to-head win rate over 2303 games are measured from current-patch OP.GG data; the mechanical reasoning — when to engage, when to back off the rage bar, and how to chain Q/E resets — is my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being kited by Gnar. Try to engage Kled whenever Irelia has 4 stacks [P] up, while being cautious of Mega Gnar’s (R).
